subject: Money
title: Satoshi Nakamoto
description: A short lesson to help you apply Satoshi Nakamoto.

hook.text: Bitcoin's creator published a 9-page paper in 2008 and vanished. Nobody knows who Satoshi is. Wallet: $50 billion.

buildup.text: The Bitcoin whitepaper described a peer-to-peer electronic cash system. No bank. No company. Just math and code.

discovery.text: Satoshi mined the first Bitcoin on January 3, 2009. The genesis block contained a headline about bank bailouts.

twist.text: Satoshi's last message was in 2011. They disappeared and never moved their estimated 1.1 million Bitcoin. Ever.

climax.text: An anonymous inventor created a $1 trillion asset class and walked away. No CEO, no company, no control. Pure protocol.

quiz.question: When was the Bitcoin genesis block mined?
